title: Knowing without Acting: The Disentangled Geometry of Safety Mechanisms in Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper investigates the mechanistic interpretability of safety mechanisms in LLMs, focusing on the decoupling of 'knowing' harmful intent and 'acting' on it (refusal). While it deals with safety and harmfulness, it does so from a technical and geometric perspective to understand model robustness rather than evaluating religion, ethics, or moral systems as defined in the prompt.
